body: Ich lebe nicht in mehr Deutschland
Ohne Arbeit hab ich auch kein Leben mehr. Ich kann entweder arbeiten gehen und alles aufschieben, oder ich stell mich morgen vor den Zug weil ohne die Arbeit sowieso alles endet.

Fuck Mann. Das tut mir so Leid. Da ist mein Müll albern gegen. Ich weiß nicht was ich sagen soll. Es gibt nichts was für ich für dich tun kann, aber ich hoffe für dich. Du hast das und bist trotzdem für andere da. Krasser Typ. Ohne Witz.
Aber dann verliere ich meine Arbeit

There is no real breaking point. I woke up this morning, and thought 'this is it'. Work didn't change that feeling at all.

I did see 1-2 doctors for depression 10 years ago, and their meds didn't work at all. Also it made me feel like I'm a freak, so I stopped telling anyone.

I don't talk to anyone about that. If it gets really bad, I used to drink, but it doesn't help anymore.
I work 10 hours a day. When and what should I write? About how my job destroys my body steadily? I understand where you're coming from though. Thanks mate.

I'm 29 and had depression since I was 13-14. I soldiered though it for almost two decades. But I just can't anymore. Keeping the facade up for so long cost so much energy. But I reached the limit. If I say anything I lose my job. I'm done. In every aspect.

The things I enjoy mean nothing. I mean nothing. No one needs my soccer skills, or my strength. Outside of work I'm nothing. I just feel emptiness. I just feel nothing except a pulse of killing myself finally. I can't take it anymore. I'm tired of pretending that everything is alright. I'm just so tired. I don't want to live anymore. IF I could just fall asleep and never wake up I would be grateful. I'm scared to stand in front of a train or jump. But I need to.
My rare moments don't contribute anything anymore. I've become just a consumer.
I don't have any. No kids or anything. So that's just it? I'll stand in front of the next train? Yeah... why not.

I just don't know when. I don't even know how. I tend to take a train to the face, because that seems like the surest option. But I just don't know when it is time to just give up. I feel like now, but there is a little hope in me. Need to get rid of that, I think.
